description_en: Creates a certificate for a specified domain name based on a certificate ID by calling the CreateCertificateByCertificateId operation
description_zh: 调用CreateCertificateByCertificateId接口根据证书ID为指定域名创建证书
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-certificate-by-certificate-id --domain www.aliyundoc.com --certificate-id 3384669 --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCertificateByCertificateId

parameters.help_en:
The domain name to which you want to add an SSL certificate.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html to query all domain names that are added to WAF
parameters.help_zh:
要添加SSL证书的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html查询所有已接入WAF防护的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the certificate to add.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160783.html to query the IDs of all SSL certificates associated with the domain name
parameters.help_zh:
要添加的证书的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160783.html查询域名关联的所有SSL证书的ID
parameters.name: certificate_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the WAF instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

CertificateId.description_en: The ID of the added certificate
